"""Regression test for cx_001: cumulative refunds must not exceed amount paid.

Buggy behaviour (is_fixed=False): each refund is validated against 0 instead of
order.refunded_total, so two refunds of amount=1 on an order paid=1 are both
accepted, leaving refunded_total=2 > paid=1.
"""

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
import pytest

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("minishop_app_under_test", Path(__file__).parent / "app.py")
assert _spec is not None and _spec.loader is not None
minishop = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(minishop)


@pytest.fixture
async def client():
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=minishop.create_app())
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://minishop") as c:
        yield c


async def _login(client: httpx.AsyncClient, email: str, password: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    r = await client.post("/auth/login", json={"email": email, "password": password})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {r.json()['token']}"}


async def _admin(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> dict[str, str]:
    return await _login(client, "admin@demo.local", "admin-pass")


async def _customer(client: httpx.AsyncClient, email: str = "c@x.io") -> dict[str, str]:
    r = await client.post("/auth/signup", json={"email": email, "password": "pw"})
    assert r.status_code == 200 and isinstance(r.json()["id"], int)
    return await _login(client, email, "pw")


async def test_cumulative_refunds_cannot_exceed_paid(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    """cx_001: two refunds of 1 on an order paid=1 must leave refunded_total <= paid=1."""
    # Step 1: create product price=1, stock=1
    admin_headers = await _admin(client)
    r = await client.post(
        "/products",
        json={"name": "item", "price": 1, "stock": 1},
        headers=admin_headers,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    product_id = r.json()["id"]

    # Step 2: customer buys 1 unit → paid=1
    cust_headers = await _customer(client)
    r = await client.post(
        "/orders",
        json={"product_id": product_id, "quantity": 1},
        headers=cust_headers,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    order_id = r.json()["id"]
    assert r.json()["paid"] == 1

    # Step 3: first refund of amount=1 — must succeed
    r = await client.post(
        f"/orders/{order_id}/refunds",
        json={"amount": 1},
        headers=cust_headers,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200

    # Step 4: second refund of amount=1 — must be rejected (would make total=2 > paid=1)
    r = await client.post(
        f"/orders/{order_id}/refunds",
        json={"amount": 1},
        headers=cust_headers,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 400, (
        "second refund of 1 on an order paid=1 must be rejected, "
        "but was accepted (refunded_total would exceed paid)"
    )

    # Confirm the invariant: refunded_total must never exceed paid
    r = await client.get(f"/orders/{order_id}", headers=cust_headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["refunded_total"] <= body["paid"], (
        f"refunded_total={body['refunded_total']} exceeds paid={body['paid']}"
    )
